Decode Coded Factor Columns Back to Original Scale

Source: R/coded_data_helpers.R
decode_brsm_data.Rd

Uses stored coding metadata to decode factor columns back to original units. This is useful for decoding prediction grids or summaries generated on coded scales.

Usage

decode_brsm_data(
  data,
  coding = NULL,
  factor_names = NULL,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  suffix = "_decoded"
)

Arguments

data

Data frame with coded factor columns.

coding

Optional coding metadata from [get_brsm_coding()]. If NULL, the function uses attr(data, "brsm_coding"), if present.

factor_names

Optional character vector of factors to decode. If NULL, decodes all factors available in coding.

overwrite

Logical; if TRUE, decoded values overwrite existing factor columns. If FALSE, decoded columns are appended with suffix.

suffix

Suffix appended to decoded column names when overwrite = FALSE.

Value

A data frame with decoded factor values.

Examples

dat <- data.frame(
  x1 = rnorm(10, 5, 2), x2 = runif(10, 10, 20), y = rnorm(10)
)
coded <- prepare_brsm_data(dat, c("x1", "x2"), method = "range")
decoded <- decode_brsm_data(coded)
